
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; padding: 1em; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; word-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在 .NET 后台开发中，数据库查询结果通常装载在 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">DataSet</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> / </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">DataTable</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 中，导出 Excel 是报表、数据导出模块非常常见的需求。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">市面上可选方案很多：EPPlus、NPOI、Office Interop 等各有取舍。Interop 需要服务器安装 Office，在服务端部署有较多限制；EPPlus 新版本有许可证变更；NPOI 开源但 API 相对底层。本文记录我使用 </span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">Free Spire.XLS for .NET</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 完成 DataSet 批量导出 Excel 的实践，它的特点是</span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">不依赖本地 Office</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，通过 NuGet 即可引入，免费版本适合小规模内部工具、后台报表场景使用。</span></p>
<blockquote style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px 20px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); background: rgba(43, 174, 133, 0.05); border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; word-break: break-all; margin: 8px 0 0; color: rgba(102, 102, 102, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">说明：Free Spire.XLS for .NET 是该库的免费分支，存在功能上限，适合非大规模生产场景评估使用，选型前建议对照自身数据量、功能需求确认是否匹配。</span></p>
</blockquote>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">环境准备</span></h2>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1. NuGet 安装包</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在项目 NuGet 包管理器搜索：</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Free Spire.XLS</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，或者命令行安装：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">Install-Package FreeSpire.XLS
</code></pre>
<blockquote style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px 20px; border-left: 4px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); background: rgba(43, 174, 133, 0.05); border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; word-break: break-all; margin: 8px 0 0; color: rgba(102, 102, 102, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">注意区分付费完整版和 Free 包，两者包名不同，不要混淆。</span></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">2. 引用命名空间</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">using System.Data;
using Spire.Xls;
</code></pre>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">核心思路</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">DataSet</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 可以包含多张 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">DataTable</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，我们希望：</span></p>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 20px; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">遍历 DataSet 内每一张数据表；</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">为每一张 DataTable 创建独立工作表，工作表名称复用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">TableName</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">；</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">使用内置 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">InsertDataTable</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 方法批量写入，避免逐行循环单元格（减少手写循环，提升代码简洁度）；</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">可选：表头加粗、自动适配列宽；</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">保存为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">.xlsx</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 文件。</span></li>
</ol>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">InsertDataTable(dataTable, includeHeader, startRow, startCol)</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 是本次用到的核心方法：第二个参数控制是否自动写入列名表头，后两个参数指定写入起始行列（从 1 开始，不是 0）。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">完整示例代码</span></h2>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">namespace DataSetExportExcelDemo
{
    internal class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            // 1. 构造模拟 DataSet（实际项目一般从数据库填充）
            DataSet dataSet = BuildSampleDataSet();
<p>// 2. 初始化工作簿<br>
Workbook workbook = new Workbook();<br>
workbook.Worksheets.Clear();</p>
<p>foreach (DataTable table in dataSet.Tables)<br>
{<br>
// 使用 TableName 作为工作表名称，做简单名称容错<br>
string sheetName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(table.TableName)<br>
? $"Sheet_{workbook.Worksheets.Count + 1}"<br>
: table.TableName;</p>
<p>Worksheet sheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add(sheetName);</p>
<p>// 将 DataTable 写入工作表，包含表头，从第1行第1列开始<br>
sheet.InsertDataTable(table, true, 1, 1);</p>
<p>// 可选美化：表头加粗<br>
if (table.Columns.Count &gt; 0)<br>
{<br>
CellRange headerRange = sheet.Range[1, 1, 1, table.Columns.Count];<br>
headerRange.Style.Font.IsBold = true;<br>
}<br>
// 可选：自动适配列宽<br>
sheet.AllocatedRange.AutoFitColumns();<br>
}</p>
<p>// 3. 保存文件<br>
string outputPath = Path.Combine(Environment.CurrentDirectory, "ExportResult.xlsx");<br>
workbook.SaveToFile(outputPath, ExcelVersion.Version2016);</p>
<p>Console.WriteLine($"导出完成：{outputPath}");<br>
}</p>
<p>/// &lt;summary&gt;<br>
/// 构造测试数据集，包含两张表<br>
/// &lt;/summary&gt;<br>
static DataSet BuildSampleDataSet()<br>
{<br>
DataSet ds = new DataSet();</p>
<p>DataTable dtProduct = new DataTable("产品表");<br>
dtProduct.Columns.Add("Id", typeof(int));<br>
dtProduct.Columns.Add("ProductName", typeof(string));<br>
dtProduct.Columns.Add("Price", typeof(decimal));<br>
dtProduct.Columns.Add("Stock", typeof(int));<br>
dtProduct.Rows.Add(1, "显示器", 1299.00, 32);<br>
dtProduct.Rows.Add(2, "键盘", 128.50, 120);<br>
dtProduct.Rows.Add(3, "鼠标", 59.00, 246);<br>
ds.Tables.Add(dtProduct);</p>
<p>DataTable dtOrder = new DataTable("订单表");<br>
dtOrder.Columns.Add("OrderId", typeof(string));<br>
dtOrder.Columns.Add("CreateTime", typeof(DateTime));<br>
dtOrder.Columns.Add("TotalAmount", typeof(decimal));<br>
dtOrder.Rows.Add("ORD20261101", new DateTime(2026, 11, 1), 1427.50);<br>
dtOrder.Rows.Add("ORD20261102", new DateTime(2026, 11, 2), 128.50);<br>
ds.Tables.Add(dtOrder);</p>
</code><p><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">return ds;<br>
}<br>
}<br>
}<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">运行后，生成的 Excel 文件会包含两个工作表：产品表、订单表，自带表头，列宽自动适配。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Web 场景：直接输出文件流下载（ASP.NET Core）</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">如果是 Web 项目，不需要落地本地文件，可以导出到内存流返回给前端下载：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// DataSet 导出 Excel 流
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
public static MemoryStream ExportDataSetToExcelStream(DataSet dataSet)
{
    Workbook workbook = new Workbook();
    workbook.Worksheets.Clear();
<p>foreach (DataTable table in dataSet.Tables)<br>
{<br>
string sheetName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(table.TableName)<br>
? $"Sheet_{workbook.Worksheets.Count + 1}"<br>
: table.TableName;<br>
Worksheet sheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add(sheetName);<br>
sheet.InsertDataTable(table, true, 1, 1);<br>
if (table.Columns.Count &gt; 0)<br>
{<br>
sheet.Range[1, 1, 1, table.Columns.Count].Style.Font.IsBold = true;<br>
}<br>
sheet.AllocatedRange.AutoFitColumns();<br>
}</p>
</code><p><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">MemoryStream ms = new MemoryStream();<br>
workbook.SaveToStream(ms, ExcelVersion.Version2016);<br>
ms.Position = 0;<br>
return ms;<br>
}<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在 Controller 中调用：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">[HttpGet("export")]
public IActionResult Export()
{
    var ds = BuildSampleDataSet();
    var stream = ExportDataSetToExcelStream(ds);
    return File(stream, "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", "报表.xlsx");
}
</code></pre>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">遇到的坑与注意事项</span></h2>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 20px; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">工作表名称限制</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">
Excel 工作表名称不能包含 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">\ / : * ? [ ]</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 等字符，</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">TableName</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 如果来自用户输入或数据库，需要提前做字符清洗，否则会抛出异常。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">免费版限制</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">
Free 版本有内置限制，适合小批量导出；如果单文件数据量很大、需要批量转换 PDF/图片等高级能力，需要评估其他方案或考虑其他库。选型时建议先压测自己的业务数据量。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">大小写、空表判断</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">
DataSet 里可能存在空 DataTable，遍历前建议增加 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">table.Rows.Count &gt; 0</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 判断，避免生成空白工作表。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">版本选择</strong><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">ExcelVersion.Version2016</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 对应 xlsx；如果需要兼容老的 .xls 格式，可以切换为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Version97to2003</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，但 xls 单表行数上限更低。</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">资源释放</strong><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">Workbook</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">、</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">MemoryStream</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 建议结合 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">using</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 管理，在高频导出接口中避免内存堆积。</span></li>
</ol>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">方案对比小结</span></h2>
<figure class="figure-table" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch"><table style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">无 Office 依赖，DataSet/DataTable 写入API简洁，支持多工作表</span></td><td style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 224, 224, 1); <hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 0; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">这套方案适合内部管理系统、小体量报表导出场景：依托 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">InsertDataTable</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 一行代码完成整张表数据灌入，不用手写双层循环写单元格，代码干净，服务端不需要安装 Office。</span></p></section>
